intro: Belize has about 420,000 people, the smallest population in Central America.

chapters.title: People
text: Mestizos, Kriols, Maya, Garífuna, Mennonites and others live in Belize. English is official, but Kriol and Spanish are widely spoken.

chapters.title: Belmopan
text: Belmopan became the capital in 1970 after a hurricane hit Belize City.
